label: Golden Light and Starlight in the Darkness

lines.text: *Rumble, rumble!*
I hear the sound of crystals erupting from every direction.
They burst through the ground, jutting up like oversized spears.
They begin to rush forward.
They surge beneath us, then cover Endless's body.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: I will reduce everything to ruin.
*Rumble, rumble!*
Endless's body is covered in crystals.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: What is this?
Dorothy once again aims her weapon at Endless.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: No! Don't shoot! Don't touch her!
Dorothy steps back.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: What's going on...?! Wasn't there supposed to be a blackout?
Enikk!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Sixo is using Endless's body to inject electricity into the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Most of the E2 Crystals crumbled during the attack, but some remaining fragments are reacting to electrical energy and expanding.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Wh-where are they coming from?!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I am unable to determine that. The plaza's cable branches throughout the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The power is spreading quickly across a large area.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: How can one Nikke produce that much power?! It makes no sense!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Her body is simply that high-end.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: She will reach a limit eventually, but by then there will be significant casualties and severe damage to the Ark's infrastructure.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: What are we supposed to do then?!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Destroy Endless as quickly as possible.
*Rumble, rumble!*

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Hyyyaah!
Neon rushes in and starts hammering at the crystal enveloping Endless.
*Crack, crack!*
Shattered crystal fragments fly everywhere. However...

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Th-they're spreading faster than I can destroy them!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Keep at it! I'll help!
Rapi! If you touch those crystals, you'll...!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: This isn't the time to argue about that!
...! All right! But be careful! Got it?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Roger that! Dorothy, you help out too!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: So we have to destroy the crystals without coming into contact with them?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Okay, I'll help.
Aaaahhh!
Gaaaah!
Eeeeeek!
Help me! Help me!
I hear cries of desperation from every direction.
I look around.
The darkness is so thick, I can barely see anything.
Crystals continue to erupt from the ground, making disturbing sounds as they do.
We are at the center of complete, uncontrollable pandemonium.
The civilians are completely exposed.
How do we... stop this...?!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: C-calm down, everyone!
They can't hear us.
Crystals block the path of those trying to flee.
One person lifts up another who has fallen and runs, only to trip on a crystal.
Another person lies face down screaming, while someone else desperately tries to drag them away.
Yet another shoves past others in a blind panic.
Someone's arm gets covered in crystal, while the person next to them struggles desperately to pull them free.
Some run past those who have fallen without looking.
Others hoist those who have fallen onto their backs and keep running.
The sound of the expanding crystals mixes with the cacophony of screams,
echoing through the darkness.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Argh! Damn it!
*Whirr*
The lighting unit that had been floating around Anis moves.
It rises above her head and casts a spotlight on her.
A speaker blares.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Everyone! Look over here!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: F-follow our instructions!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Don't panic, but get away from anything electronic!
Neither the light nor Anis's voice reaches the people.
They remain trapped in the darkness.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Grrraaaahhh!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Tch...! How are they expanding so fast?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: What kind of monster did you create, Enikk?!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I am sorry.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Get away from there! There are crystals about to shoot up!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We're running out of ground to stand on! At this rate...!
Anis shouts at the top of her lungs.
The people don't hear her.
She increases the brightness of the light.
Still, no one turns to look.
She surveys the chaos of the plaza.
She sees stars shining in the darkness.
A man running with two people on his back, paying no mind to his own blood-soaked head.
A woman picking up a crying child up from the ground and running, despite her limp.
The ones shoving others aside and abandoning those who have fallen don't even register to Anis.
She only sees the stars who're lighting the way for others.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: This is bad...! How far is it going to spread?!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Enikk! What's the status?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The crystals' expansion is accelerating. At this current rate, the entire Ark will be overtaken by E2 Crystals within ten hours.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... What?!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Sixo!
This can't be happening...
The Ark is breaking apart.
If we don't stop it soon, there won't even be an Ark anymore.
And after I finally figured things out...
I finally realized that the Ark isn't just full of terrible people.
I don't want it to go away.
I hate the Ark, I really do, but... I don't want it gone.
It hurt me, and even betrayed me,
but there were also a lot of days where I laughed and had fun.
Those small memories became like stars to me.
I found my own stars, all thanks to the people here.
It was those tiny stars that kept me going.
I was able to push through the suffocating darkness and survive.
It's because of all of you that I fell into despair, and it's because of all of you that I found hope.
I guess I can't deny it...
This festering trash heap they call the Ark, and everyone in it...
I love you all.
A small light begins to shine...
So...
Look at me.
It grows brighter...
Watch me shine.
Look at me and hold onto hope.
And brighter...
I did it before, and now you can too!
The Ark grows brighter.
Light pours out from Anis's body.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Aaahhh...!
*Rumble, rumble!*
A trail of crystals begins to bolt toward Anis.
More follow suit, until all the crystals in the area are headed for her, attracted to the sudden surge of energy.
However, they quickly shatter and dissolve.
The particles from the shattered crystal float over to Anis.
She begins to shine even brighter.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: ... I'm reassessing the situation.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I've detected a change in all the E2 Crystals in the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Their energy is being drained by Anis.
... What?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The E2 Crystals are rapidly being neutralized.
Countless rays of light embroider the Ark's sky,
and then all shoot towards Anis.
Her body turns white as it continues to gather light.
The surroundings brighten until it feels like midday.
I glance around.
Everyone is looking at Anis.
Rapi! Dorothy!
Evacuate the civilians!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ...! Roger that!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: What? We should deal with that as quickly as...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Let's go! Hurry!
Rapi and Dorothy quickly get to work evacuating nearby civilians.
I turn back to look at Endless.
She is still trapped in the crystal.
Firepower! Firepower!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Firepower! Firepower!
Neon steadies herself.
Firepower! Firepower! Firepower!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: You want me to really let loose now that the area's been cleared, right? I got you!
*Boom! Boom! Boom!*
Neon keeps firing at Endless.
The explosions obliterate the crystals, revealing Endless beneath.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: How...?
Endless's shocked expression is swallowed by the next blast.
She is hurled through the air, battered around by one explosion after another.
The blasts continue in such quick succession that she doesn't even have time to raise her hand and form a light projectile.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: How is this possible... with no recoil?!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: The answer's obvious, isn't it? It's one of the wonders of having a healthy body!

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: That's absurd...!
Endless is consumed by explosions.
Like driftwood caught in a whirlpool, she is tossed around helplessly.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Aghhh...! Not here...!

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Not... in this darkness...!

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: I won't allow myself to fade away!
Suddenly, the ground starts to rise up.
It forms a wall in front of Endless.
The wall is destroyed instantly by Neon's blasts, but Endless is able to distance herself during that brief gap.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: What...? Why did the ground suddenly move?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: This is an emergency.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Sixo has unlocked a hidden function in Endless.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: What?! What is it?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Gravity control.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: ... What?
Further from the main site,
Rapi and Dorothy are utilizing their extreme mobility to evacuate the civilians.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: How many are left?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: About half.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Ugh...! We need to move faster!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Okay.
Rapi thrusts off the ground using Seven Dwarves Zero.
Just as Dorothy prepares to follow, someone taps her shoulder.

lines.speaker: fearfulcitizen
lines.text: Y-you're an angel, aren't you?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: An angel...?

lines.speaker: fearfulcitizen
lines.text: Y-yeah. During the terrorist attack on the Ark, you're the one who descended from the sky.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... Yeah, that was me, but I'm no angel.

lines.speaker: fearfulcitizen
lines.text: Th-thank you! You saved us back then...

lines.speaker: fearfulcitizen
lines.text: and now you've saved us again...

lines.speaker: fearfulcitizen
lines.text: I wanted to make sure I thanked you this time.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Don't mention it.

lines.speaker: fearfulcitizen
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to hold you up.

lines.speaker: fearfulcitizen
lines.text: Please, go. The others need your help too.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Sure. Leave it to me.
Dorothy launches into the air.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Huh... I didn't expect you to implant such a function into a Nikke.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: You really are something else, Enikk.
Endless shoots upward at high speed.
She spreads both arms.
A rumbling sound can be heard below.
... The ground lifts again.
Chunks of buildings tear free and rise into the air.
The fragments gather and fuse into a monumental floating mass.
The colossal structure floating in the air looks entirely surreal.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Uh, isn't this all getting a bit too sci-fi?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That functionality was provided by Elysion for testing. It was not anticipated that Sixo would unlock it.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Ingrid's always going on about being tactical, and yet here she is messing with sci-fi gravity tech?! I'm disappointed in her!
Same!

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Summoning unforeseen strength when cornered...

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Would you not consider that a very human response? Hehe.
Endless extends her hand.
The floating mass starting falling toward us.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: I will crush you all.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Warning: that falling landmass will strike a critical blow to the Ark should it make contact.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Master!
Engage in a frontal assault, Neo-Neon!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Neo-Neon, moving out!
Neon showers the falling mass with bullets.
The edges are shaved off,
and slowly but surely, she forces it back.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: ... You can't be serious.
The ground and buildings nearby are torn up and added to the giant mass.
However, it still fails to advance even an inch.
A golden ring flares in Neon's eyes.
Gold light radiates both from her body and her gun.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Firepower, firepower, firepower, firepower!!
*Rat-tat-tat-tat!*

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Her firing speed is... increasing? As is her power...!

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Those golden particles...! Are they some kind of catalyst?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: They're firepower particles!

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Don't lie to me.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: My bad!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Agh!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Hot, hot!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Ow, ow, ow! I turned off my pain sensors, but it still hurts!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Wh-whoa, I've never seen that warning display pop up! How hot am I...?!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: E2 Crystals across the Ark continue to be neutralized.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Anis, your body temperature has far exceeded the acceptable limit. I recommend immediately ceasing what you are doing.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: What about... the people...?!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Rapi and Dorothy have evacuated most civilians from this area.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Are... they... watching me?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes. The citizens here are currently focused on you.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Citizens in other locations around the Ark are also looking in this direction.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: This is because you are the only light source in the Ark at present.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: In that case... I can't... stop...!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Your core has begun to melt. It will be completely melted in one minute.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: What about the crystals...?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Analyzing...

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I can confirm that all E2 Crystals across the Ark have been neutralized.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Cease what you are doing, Anis.
Anis! Stop!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Heheh... Sorry, but I don't know... how to make it stop...
Anis's body is completely white. Her surroundings start to sway.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: At least... I know...

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I've done enough...
No, you're not done yet.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: ... The core meltdown has halted. Temperatures have stabilized.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Correction: all energy is being transferred to the expansive armament Star.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The expansive armament Star is being disassembled and reallocated.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Some portions are adhering to the damaged core. Integration is in progress.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Wh-what's going on?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I do not know.
A burst of light erupts from Anis's body.

lines.speaker: anis_i_s
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: anis_i_s
lines.text: Suddenly I feel really light.

lines.speaker: anis_i_s
lines.text: And what're these clothes? Are they even clothes? I feel like I'm soaking in a lukewarm bath.
Anis turns to look at Endless and Neon.
Neon is attacking a giant mass the size of a building.
Anis feels she needs to hurry and join her.
She moves. Her weapon is gone, and she has no idea what's happening, but she moves all the same.
She jumps, and immediately finds herself high up in the air.

lines.speaker: anis_i_s
lines.text: Wh-what the...?
The distance closes rapidly.
Anis notices something strange.
She can see Neon's bullets fly through the air.
They move slowly, strike the mass, and explode.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Aaanisss, pleeease explaaain yourrr currrent staaate.
Enikk's voice is slowed down, and Anis wonders if she's playing a joke on her.

lines.speaker: anis_i_s
lines.text: Uh... I'm not entirely sure, but I do feel pretty great.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: You'rrre speaaakinggg too quiiicklyyy.
Anis looks around again.
It's all slow.
Everything is unnaturally slow.
She can see bullets as they fly. Explosions unfurl slowly. It feels like she could reach out and grab the debris scattering through the air.
Suddenly, she realizes what's happening.
The moment she lands, she runs.
She streaks past Neon and leaps again.
She steps onto the gigantic mass and runs across its surface.
At the far end, she sees Endless floating.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: ... Whaaat...?

lines.speaker: anis_i_s
lines.text: Beaaats meee, moooronnn.
Anis hurls herself at Endless.
She has no weapon, and she doubts she can suddenly shoot lasers from her hands,
so she decides to just use her fists.

lines.speaker: anis_i_s
lines.text: I can just punch her, right...?
Anis lunges and swings at Endless.
Her face crumples beneath the force of the punch.
Anis knows she still has plenty of time left.
She decides to use every second she has...
... to throw as many punches as she can.

lines.speaker: anis_i_s
lines.text: Get the hell out of the Ark, you freaking virus!
Anis's fists rain down on Endless without mercy.
And time begins to move normally again for Anis.
What...?
*Boom! Boom! Boom!*
... One moment, I see Anis start to flash white, and then the next moment, she's disappeared.
Then all of a sudden, light erupts from Endless's body.
Still floating in midair, Endless is hurled about by bursts of light.
Anis lands.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Oh, time's moving normally again.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: And... my clothes are back to normal.
Anis, what just happened?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I-I don't really know, but I think...

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Master! Anis! It's collapsing!
The massive construct Endless created begins to break apart and fall to the ground.
Endless is also plummeting to the ground.
Don't let her get away!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Firrrepowerrr!
Neon unleashes a relentless barrage of bullets.
Almost at the same time, I notice a red light and a white light approaching from far away.
Rapi is flying at high speed using Seven Dwarves Zero.
Alongside her is Dorothy.
Rapi! Dorothy! Finish this!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Roger that!
Every single one of Neon's rounds strikes the falling Endless.
Rapi's drill pierces straight through her,
while Dorothy's gunfire lashes in from all directions, hitting her mark.
Endless plummets powerlessly to the ground.
She lands with a loud thud, making a small crater in the ground.
Endless lies motionless, her body in ruins.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Endless has ceased functioning.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I detect no E2 Crystals anywhere in the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: We have won.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Phew! Great job, everyone.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Right back at you, Anis.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You as well, Dorothy.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I still don't know what just happened...

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: But what matters is that we wo...
Anis falls silent and scans her surroundings.
People are gathering.
They stare at the devastated plaza with fear in their eyes.
The threat has been neutralized. It's okay now, everyone.
Nothing in their expression changes. It's as if they didn't hear me.
Anis crouches down.
She gathers light into her hand.
Then, without a word,
she raises her arm high towards the sky.
There is a quick flash,
and Anis's body begins to shine.
The people all turn to look at her.
They see Anis, shining alone in the darkness of the Ark.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: We won!
Light fills their eyes,
and after a brief pause,
the crowd erupts into cheering.
Anis stands there, taking in their gazes and their cheers,
while she smiles brighter than she ever had before.
